name: LockIN
tagline: A Chrome extension that tases you for slacking
summary: You give it a blacklist of sites. Stay on one too long and it plays a taser sound until you leave.

name: JJK Slander Bot
tagline: A Discord bot that turns you into a Jujutsu Kaisen meme
summary: Say a trigger word like "potential" and it pulls a slander meme of that character, finds the face with a YOLOv8 anime detector, checks it with a ViT classifier, and pastes your profile picture over it.

name: Reddit Meme Crawler
tagline: Every image in a Reddit thread, from one post ID
summary: A Devvit app that grabs all the images in a post and its comments. It's where the slander bot gets its meme supply.

name: MamboIfier
tagline: Re-sings any song with two syllables
summary: Record someone saying "mambo mambo" once. The pipeline chops it into syllables, then re-sings a whole song with them, matching the original vocal's pitch and timing before autotuning the result.

name: RitoPaint
tagline: Draw on League replays and the ink stays on the ground
summary: A transparent overlay that reads the camera pose from League's Replay API, so your arrows and circles stay pinned to the map as the camera pans.

name: LinkedInDestroyer
tagline: Blows a hole through LinkedIn posts that mention AI
summary: A Chrome extension that charges up, fires, and leaves a hole straight through any post that says AI, GPT, LLM or agentic. No server, nothing leaves your machine.

name: Genshin Soundpact
tagline: Yu-Peng Chen's Genshin music, mapped across Teyvat
summary: An interactive map of the regional soundtracks Yu-Peng Chen wrote, with the pieces that inspired them and side-by-side comparisons you can play, one track in each ear.

name: Flow Balance Bench HMI
tagline: Operator screen for a multi-channel flow balancing bench
summary: The operator screen for my Georgia Tech capstone with Donaldson, a test bench that balances flow across several channels. One self-contained HTML page.
